messages:
maria: Heads up — EmeraldBank asked for a firm commitment on Private deployment + Dedicated capacity for their EU PII workloads. They put GA = 2026-10-15 in the LOI and want 99.95% p95 latency at ~1k qps plus data residency in eu-west1. @sam @julian can we confirm feasibility?

sam: Quick clarifying Qs: is this full Private (control plane in their VPC) + Dedicated GPU pool + customer KMS + SAML/SCIM integration? and do they expect cutover support from our SRE team? @lex might know integration scope.

lex: Yep — they listed VPC Private, customer-managed KMS, and SAML provisioning. SE estimate: ~2 sprints for integration + docs for pilot; can prep pilot sooner than GA.

julian: Engineering readout: the combined scope (private control plane + reserved dedicated + KMS + SAML) is non-trivial. Phased delivery is realistic:
  - Phase 1 (pilot): private control plane + baseline dedicated pool by 2026-09-30
  - Phase 2 (GA): full KMS integration + SAML + production SLOs by 2026-10-31
Can't guarantee Oct 15 GA without compressing other work or buying priority capacity.

maria: :thinking_face: Sales says Emerald's CFO expects Oct 15. They mentioned penalty language in the LOI. Any ways to compress timeline?

nina: We can provision a reserved Dedicated slot if they sign by 2026-08-01 and provide a ramp payment. That could shave ~2–3 weeks. Also security team can fast-track KMS integration if we pin resources.

sam: Proposed compromise: commit to a pilot (private control plane + reserved dedicated capacity with limited SLOs) by 2026-09-20, and GA (all SLOs + customer KMS + SAML) by 2026-10-31. Offer a contractual credit if GA slips past Oct 15. @legal-bot can you draft an amendment?

legal-bot: Drafting amendment template now — needs explicit milestone definitions and credit formula. Please provide technical acceptance criteria for both pilot and GA so we can avoid ambiguity. @julian please chime in.

julian: Technical acceptance suggestions:
  - Pilot acceptance: deployable private control plane, ingest test traffic at 1k qps with pilot SLO p95 <=200ms and basic auth/KMS stubbed.
  - GA acceptance: p95 <=120ms under sustained 1k qps, encryption at rest with customer KMS, SAML SCIM provisioning, and documented runbook + oncall rotation. I'll post a full checklist to Confluence.

lex: I'll own the SE onboarding and pilot runbook. I'll create a Confluence page with milestones, test plan, and responsibilities and tag stakeholders.

maria: I'll push back with the customer and present the pilot + firm GA Oct 31 path, plus contractual credit if we miss Oct 15. @sam please assemble cost delta and contract terms so we can negotiate. Anyone opposed?

sam: No objections. I'll update the roadmap and map this into Q4 OKRs (Private deployments priority) and flag as a customer-driven deliverable for PLT.

nina: :white_check_mark: I'll tentatively reserve the capacity slot contingent on contract signature by 2026-08-01.

maria: Action items recap: @sam update roadmap & OKRs, @legal-bot draft amendment with credit language, @lex create pilot runbook, @julian publish technical acceptance checklist. I'll sync with EmeraldBank EOD tomorrow and share the Confluence link.

maria: cc: @sam @julian @nina @lex — please update your tasks in the shared doc so I can include timelines in the customer call.
